info.title: RazorFormatter CLI
info.description: Fast, deterministic, Prettier-grade code formatter for ASP.NET Core Razor (.cshtml and .razor) files.

options.name: --server
options.description: Run as a long-running JSON-RPC formatting daemon

options.name: --changes-json
options.description: Output minimal text edits and diagnostics as JSON

options.name: --check
options.description: Check if files are formatted (exits with code 1 if not)

options.name: --indent
options.description: Number of spaces per indentation level (default: 4)

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Glob pattern to ignore (can be used multiple times)
